title: Organisational Cognition Runtime / Recursive Knowledge Compiler - Bridge Handover
origin: ChatGPT session with Troy Latter, 2026-05-18 Australia/Sydney

intent.summary: Build and operationalise a daily and historical LLM-chat intelligence loop that detects repeated questions, recurring uncertainty, governance ambiguity, and repeated operational clarifications; when thresholds are met, promote them into canonical house rules and runtime governance.
intent.user_language: All questions that keep getting asked multiple times need to become house rules. If a question hits four days in a row, or the fourth time someone asks it, it goes to house rule. Research as-is, detect recurrence, canonicalise, and enforce.
intent.business_product_frame: White-label Organisational Cognition Runtime / Runtime Coherence Infrastructure for institutional memory, governance drift detection, survivability, and cognition-cost reduction.

example_questions: What region should CloudFormation nesting use?
canonical_examples.expected_rule_candidate: Canonical AWS account and deployment region must be recorded as a house rule and injected into CloudFormation, Lambda, Bridge, orchestration, prompts, and validators. ap-southeast-2 is currently assumed but must be verified from live receipts before REAL.

example_questions: Does troy-fire-orchestrator represent the intended C2 spine?
Is there a separate COAX/Pen orchestration layer already designed?
canonical_examples.expected_rule_candidate: Define canonical control-plane topology: COAX as cognition/governance layer, Pen as ingress and receipt path, Bridge as execution transport, troy-fire-orchestrator as candidate runtime execution spine if verified, Synapse as production surface, Gatekeeper as promotion authority. Mark PARTIAL until verified.

runtime_requirements.daily_loop: Run daily against newly available LLM chats and operational sources.
runtime_requirements.historical_loop: Backfill past LLM chats and existing artefacts to identify accumulated repeated questions and unresolved ambiguity.

thresholds.four_total_mentions: Promote to house-rule candidate on fourth occurrence ever.
thresholds.four_consecutive_days: Mandatory escalation if substantially similar question appears across four consecutive days.
thresholds.post_rule_recurrence: If a question repeats after canonicalisation, classify as drift/discoverability/enforcement failure.

runtime_requirements.evidence_policy: REAL requires live receipts, telemetry continuity, runtime proof, and evidence ledger entries. Otherwise classify as PARTIAL. PRETEND is rejected.
runtime_requirements.expected_path: Hosted LLM commits JSON to TML-4PM/the-pen/inbox; Pen GitHub Action/worker executes via Bridge; receipt written to receipts/runtime plus audit evidence.

proposed_data_model.audit.evidence_register: Use existing evidence register where possible; record commit, worker, runtime, telemetry, and validation receipts.

white_label_requirements.tenant_isolation: Each customer has isolated cognition graph, embeddings, governance rules, evidence, and telemetry.
white_label_requirements.market_positioning: Institutional survivability and runtime coherence infrastructure, not a static knowledge base.

bridge_tasks.task: Create or verify Supabase governance schema for question_clusters, house_rules, rule_propagation, and reality_drift.
bridge_tasks.acceptance: Schema exists with PKs, timestamps, status/evidence fields, and RLS/governance posture recorded.

bridge_tasks.task: Create ingestion worker for LLM chat history and daily delta runs.
bridge_tasks.acceptance: Worker can ingest sample historical bundle and one daily delta; writes source refs and clusters.

bridge_tasks.task: Implement recurrence thresholds: fourth total mention and four consecutive days.
bridge_tasks.acceptance: Test fixtures show candidate rule creation on threshold breach.

bridge_tasks.task: Generate first two candidate house rules from supplied examples: AWS canonical region/account and canonical C2 spine.
bridge_tasks.acceptance: Rules created as PARTIAL unless verified by live runtime/source receipts.

bridge_tasks.task: Wire evidence receipts to audit.evidence_register and GitHub receipts/runtime.
bridge_tasks.acceptance: Each worker run produces receipt with job id, commit/ref, counts, created rules, evidence state.

bridge_tasks.task: Produce dashboard-ready output for top repeated questions, candidate rules, unresolved ambiguity, and drift.
bridge_tasks.acceptance: JSON/API view exists for command centre widget or equivalent UI.

minimum_real: Bridge/Pen worker picks up this payload
at least one DB/audit/evidence record created or explicit blocker recorded
